stories.title: MLB lockout looming — CBA expires December 1, Cubs rotation rebuild in jeopardy
stories.angle: The CBA expires December 1, 2026 — 40 days from now. Owners have proposed a $245.3M salary cap / $171.2M floor. MLBPA opposes. Lockout widely expected by multiple analysts (ESPN, CBS Sports). Cubs need to rebuild their entire starting rotation before the freeze hits — could lose Gausman, Holmes, Peterson, Imanaga, Boyd to free agency.

Cubs need to rebuild their rotation before the freeze hits. ⏰

stories.title: World Series Game 1 TOMORROW — Brewers vs. Rays, starters confirmed
stories.angle: Game 1 is Friday Oct 23, 8 PM ET on FOX at American Family Field. Brewers (103-59, best record in baseball) host Rays (98-64). Probable starters: Jacob Misiorowski (MIL) vs. Drew Rasmussen (TAM). First Brewers World Series since 1982. Rays still chasing first title. Cubs fans watching their division rival 14 games ahead of them try to win the championship.

stories.title: Gold Glove sweep potential — PCA leads MLB with 26 OAA, winners Nov. 1
stories.angle: Gold Glove winners announced Sunday November 1. PCA leads all of baseball with 26 Outs Above Average (+26 Fielding Run Value). Five Cubs are NL finalists: PCA (CF), Happ (LF), Suzuki (RF), Bregman (3B), Swanson (SS). If PCA, Happ, and Suzuki all win, Cubs would be first team in MLB history to sweep all three outfield Gold Gloves in one season.

stories.title: John Mallee — Mets interviewing Cubs assistant hitting coach
stories.angle: MLB.com (Anthony DiComo, Oct 20): Mets are interviewing Cubs assistant hitting coach John Mallee for their coaching staff vacancy. Mallee worked closely with PCA and helped Cubs lead MLB in runs (850), slugging (.428), OPS (.767) in 2026. Kevin Long also a candidate. No offer yet as of Oct 21. Framed as org analysis — not transaction announcement.

stories.title: George Kirby trade target — Bleacher Report predicts Cubs to land Mariners starter
stories.angle: Bleacher Report analyst Zachary Rymer predicts Cubs will trade for Mariners starter George Kirby this offseason. Kirby, 28, under team control through 2028. Matt Shaw floated as possible trade chip. Cubs need starters; Mariners need infield help. Prior interest established pre-deadline (August). This is a prediction/analysis piece, not a confirmed trade report.
